games.title: The Boolean Blacksmith
games.description: You have a new role: "Senior Backend Engineer" specializing in distributed systems, located in Vienna, Austria. The client requires experience with Go (Golang) and Kubernetes. They have a strong preference for candidates who have contributed to open-source projects.
games.task: Craft the most effective Boolean search string to find these candidates on a professional networking site.

games.title: The Persona Profiler
games.description: Analyze the job description for a "Lead UX Designer" and create a concise candidate persona. Focus on key skills, experience level, and potential motivations.
games.task: Write a short candidate persona (3-4 sentences) that captures the essence of the ideal candidate.
